about_the_game:
Nestling Rush is a cozy, fast-paced matching game about reuniting adorable babies with their mothers before the clock runs out. Guide each little one to the correct mother, keep your streak alive, and chase a new personal best.

Each round, mothers and babies appear in fresh random spots to keep you on your toes. Correct matches earn points and extra seconds—make three mistakes and your run ends.

With charming visuals, snappy rounds, and an easy-to-learn loop that steadily ramps up the pressure, Nestling Rush shines in quick breaks and long, comfy late-night sessions alike.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
